LanguageData.AG_OriginBladeStudyHelp: Select an undrafted colonist and right-click a blade on the ground to study it. Each study takes one hour and leaves the weapon intact. Study five distinct melee weapon types with cutting or stabbing attacks; material and quality variants count only once. For example: knife, ikwa, spear, gladius, and longsword. Completed studies are permanent. Interrupted studies must be restarted. Once all three requirements are met you will be asked whether to awaken; the choice is yours and it is permanent. Declining is not final - this command becomes the awaken button, so the pawn can be taken through later. Awakening survives any later decline in skill.
LanguageData.AG_OriginBladeWarning: Awakening permanently removes all psycasts and psylink levels and prevents future psycast progression. The pawn can no longer equip ranged weapons (guns, bows, or launchers); any equipped ranged weapon will be unequipped. Unlimited Blade Works remains usable. Psychic sensitivity is unchanged.

LanguageData.AG_OriginBladeAwakenText: {0} has understood five blade types and has the hands and the eye to go with them. They can take Origin: Blade now, gaining Unlimited Blade Works permanently.\n\nThis choice cannot be undone. Declining costs nothing: the Origin: Blade command becomes an awaken button, and they can be taken through at any time.
